title: Auto Farm and Fast Farm
features:
✅ Auto Farm – Automatically targets and attacks enemies for efficient grinding.
✅ Auto Punch Attack – Continuously punches enemies until they are defeated.
✅ Auto Pet Attack – Sends pets to attack enemies when within range.
✅ Customizable Attack Distance – Pets start attacking enemies when they are 20 studs away.
✅ Enemy Prioritization – Sorts enemies by distance and targets the closest ones first.
✅ Health Detection – Avoids attacking dead enemies and moves to the next target.
✅ Auto Arise – Automatically attempts to capture defeated enemies.
✅ Auto Destroy – Deletes defeated enemies after combat.
✅ Smart Pathfinding – Uses TweenService to move towards enemies smoothly.
✅ Debugging & Notifications – Prints status updates and sends in-game notifications.
